themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems or data to achieve research goals.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers tools and techniques that use AI to help developers write, debug, refactor, and understand code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles discussing platforms, software, or frameworks designed to facilitate or enhance the research process through AI.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Explores the creation and use of AI-generated individuals or personas for testing, simulation, or understanding user behavior without real participants.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI's ability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries, extracting key insights.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to analyze complex datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable insights.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in product development, strategy, roadmapping, and decision-making processes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Articles specifically on the research, development, and impact of AI chatbots in various contexts.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Focuses on comparative analyses and reviews of different AI tools and platforms used for research purposes.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines the integration of AI into the workflows of designers and researchers to enhance creativity, efficiency, and insights.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
